about: Technical snapshot for liquid US stocks (S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 leaders, plus RCL). RSI is Wilder's 14-day RSI. Bollinger Bands are the 20-day average plus and minus two population standard deviations. Moving averages are simple. Drawdowns use trading sessions (5 and 21). The bounce score mixes a low RSI, a lower-band touch, a bullish uptick or hammer, and heavier volume. Informational only, not financial advice. fetchedAt is when this file was last filled. A failed fetch keeps the previous rows.
disclaimer: Technical indicator screener for informational use only. Not financial advice.
source: Yahoo Finance public daily chart API (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart).
universe: S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 leaders, plus RCL
